name: Captions
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Captions, caption and reframe user-owned short videos with local models. The hard boundary is proprietary editing models, mobile capture, avatars, cloud rendering, and creator workflow, plus models, compute, rights, and safety operations.
